Real life fostering. Real rescue. Real impact.

Follow along as we foster kittens, support our shelter animals at Chain of Hope, and show what rescue actually looks like day to day.

It’s messy, emotional, chaotic and completely worth it.

⛓️‍💥What you’ll see:
• Feline fosters
• Day in the life at the shelter
• Rescue + outreach work
• The highs, the heartbreak, and everything in between

If you’ve ever thought about fostering, or just love animals, you’re in the right place.

🐾 Want to help animals too?
Donate: https://checkout.shelterluv.com/donate/chkc
